Meta.description: On-chain K-pop photocard vault and marketplace: cards vaulted in Seoul, ownership as Solana NFTs, settled in USDT, redeemable anytime.
Meta.vaultDescription: Every vaulted photocard with its Solana NFT, holder and status, publicly verifiable.

Hero.body: Send your cards to Idolca. Once authenticated, each one gets its own NFT on Solana. When it sells, the card stays in the vault while the NFT and USDT swap in a single transaction, so no more mailing cards back and forth or worrying about fakes. Want to hold it? Burn the NFT and we ship it anywhere.
Hero.hint: Drag to rotate and see the back

Market.title: Trending cards
Market.subtitle: All cards are vaulted and authenticated. Ownership transfers on-chain the moment a trade settles.

How.title: Cards stay in the vault, trading happens on-chain
How.subtitle: No more unshipped orders, fakes or cross-border postage. Every card has a unique serial and its full history is public on-chain.
How.s1Body: Mail your cards to our Seoul vault, or open albums online and have your pulls vaulted directly.
How.s2Body: Each card is authenticated and scanned front and back, then minted as its own NFT on Solana.
How.s3Body: The card never moves. An escrow program swaps the NFT and USDT in one transaction, and you can also trade on Magic Eden or Tensor.
How.s4Body: Request redemption and the NFT is frozen, then burned when the card ships. Combine several cards into one worldwide shipment.

Vault.intro: Every card in the vault maps to one Metaplex Core NFT. The number of unburned NFTs always equals the number of physical cards: NFTs of cards being redeemed are frozen, and burned when the card ships.
Vault.demo: Demo data. Set HELIUS_API_KEY and NEXT_PUBLIC_CARD_COLLECTION to read the on-chain collection.
